why: The rung above stun-first, and the first one asked for by a commit rather than by a form. ci-138 says the clone arm has one lever left: a clone lands on its teacher exactly and tightly, so a better clone needs a better teacher (journal, 2026-09-17). stun-first is that teacher today, and this searches from it with it in the panel, the way pressure-floor was searched from mixture-mean with it in the panel. The opponent list is greedy, stun-first and random: a candidate scores the mean over the three and one that falls below the start against any of them ranks below every one that did not, so it cannot win by learning one opponent (journal, 2026-09-16). The check opponent is search-4, which is off that line entirely -- a set that beats the three it was searched against and falls against a fourth learned those three rather than the game. What would make this worth a rung: a set that beats stun-first on seeds it never saw, since stun-first already takes every match from Greedy and from Random and there is no room left on those two.
